limitations: Counts wording, not meaning: a conclusion restated in new words is found only through --claims or reading.
Candidates, not errors. A family below its threshold is not reported; a reported one may be justified.
Reads the same scope as editorial-check: frontmatter, JSX props and alt text are not covered. Use rendered-check.mjs on the built page.
